lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 replaced the bare relative hook command path with the env-var absolute form: ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh in both .claude/settings.json and templates/.claude/settings.json. The embed-vendor was regenerated. Official Claude Code hooks docs confirm ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} is the correct placeholder for project-root-relative paths; hooks run in unpredictable CWDs so bare relative paths can silently fail-open. Both copies are now identical and byte-parity clean.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Docs confirm ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} is the safe form for hook command paths; hooks run with unpredictable CWD, making bare relative paths unsafe. Fix matches official recommendation.
